title: MFA hardening: hash backup codes + DB code store
goal: Deliver deterministic, persistent, rate-limited MFA backup and verification-code behavior that remains correct across deploys and replays

in: MFA backup-code hashing and one-time redemption
Authoritative additive verification-code schema, server-only repository, RLS/ACL boundary, and deterministic focused verification
out: Hosted migration application, destructive reset/replay, and production changes
Canonical database type regeneration before the migration is staged

Focused MFA tests complete without timing flakes and the account lifecycle staging suite passes
